> **DSCWoC Label Guide:** The project admin will assign a difficulty label (`level-1`, `level-2`, or `level-3`) and a task-based label (e.g., `bug`, `feature`, `ui/ux`, `enhancement`, `documentation`, `refactor`, `testing`) after reviewing this issue.
